name: Screen-space Post-processing
definition: A full-screen post-processing pipeline that applies aspect-ratio preserving UV covering, luminance-based bright pass, color grading, underwater RGB channel splitting, cross-shaped bloom, 17-tap box blur, and 1-LSB dithering to a scene texture.
summary: Screen-space post-processing applies aesthetic effects to the final 2D image, differing from ray-casting by operating entirely in screen space rather than during volumetric traversal.
